out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at each handwashing sink. Two of three hand sinks, one at the three vat sink and one in the food prep area, did not have hand soap at them.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. The PIC went to the grocery store during the inspection to purchase hand soap.

violations.title: Air Gaps/Breaks
violations.observation: The sprayer hose on the 3-vat sink was hanging too low and creating a potential backflow issue.
violations.corrective_action: An air gap between the water supply inlet and the flood level rim of the plumbing fixture, equipment, or nonfood equipment shall be at least twice the diameter of the water supply inlet and may not be less than one inch. Adjust, repair or replace the spray hose so that it hangs above the flood level rim of the top of the sink basin. Correct within 3 days. A follow-up is required for this. The manager talked to staff and had them hang the sprayer on the hook when not in use until corrected.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: Observed gaps at the bottom of the front doors where they meet the floor (light from outside visible under the doors). These gaps will allow pests to enter the establishment with the doors closed.
violations.corrective_action: To correct, repair or replace the door seals. There should be no outside light visible under the door gaps when properly repaired or replaced. Correct with six months.
